super6.race: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Has a win/close second in 2 previous course starts. Strong form when third at Fakenham in May before easily winning on return at Fontwell (19f) latest. Going the right way, but this demands a fair bit more improvement again.

super6.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
super6.comment: Wootton Bassett colt who showed a bit more than on debut when fifth of 10 in novice at Newmarket (7f, good to soft) 17 days ago. Upped in trip but looks one for the longer term.

super6.race: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
super6.comment: Three-time C&D winner who scrambled home in a thin 0-95 at Redcar on penultimate start. Bit to find at the weights, even if stepping forward from his recent Catterick run (beaten 2½ lengths following 10 weeks away).

super6.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
super6.comment: In excellent form on all-weather at the start of the year with 3 wins (including over C&D). Ran better than for a while when beaten 2 lengths at Chelmsford (1¼m) latest. Only 1 lb above his winning mark now and place claims if they go a good pace here.

finals.race: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Bathyrhon gelding who was well backed and built on debut promise after 5 months off when winning 5-runner bumper at Sedgefield (17f, good) just over 4 weeks ago, responding well. Promises to be suited by this trip now hurdling so he's high on the shortlist.

finals.race: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Went close at Huntingdon latest hurdle start in spring 2025. Improved over fences last season, winning 4 of his 8 starts (including on reappearance). Potentially well treated off 7 lb lower hurdles mark and jockey has at least gone close a couple of times under Rules.

finals.race: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Came from further back than ideal when third to pair of next-time-out winners at Fontwell in May. Some mitigation for a handful of no-shows across both codes since. Isn't one to totally dismiss at bigger prices.

finals.race: John Weight Gone But Not Forgotten Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Almost threw it away with a bad mistake at the last but he did gain win number 3 over fences here in February. Placed both starts at Huntingdon soon after and has gone well fresh previously. Shortlisted.

finals.race: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Looked about as good as ever when notching a fifth career success with ease at Sandown (2½m) 8 days ago, travelling well before sealing the race with a burst of speed between the last 2. Turned out quickly without a penalty, and he's one of a handful on an attractive mark.

finals.race: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Has a win/close second in 2 previous course starts. Strong form when third at Fakenham in May before easily winning on return at Fontwell (19f) latest. Going the right way, but this demands a fair bit more improvement again.

finals.race: More Radio Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: A 3-time chase winner since last hurdling, he should be suited by a sharp track, but from 1 lb out of the handicap he will need to translate something close to his best fences form back to this sphere to make a serious impact.

finals.race: Neville Hall 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Infrequent winner but arrives in good form on the level, coming in for an overly-confident ride when third of 13 at Leicester (1½m, heavy) 3 weeks ago. Handicapper given him a chance back hurdling so holds solid each-way claims.

finals.race: Neville Hall 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Made a winning debut in bumpers for Milton Harris in 2023. Lightly raced and mostly well held over hurdles since, including when last seen at Uttoxeter in July. Back from 4 months off and assessor eases his grip further.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: 18,000 gns 2-y-o, Starman filly. Dam unraced sister to useful winner up to 7f Elegant Erin. Looks limited on early evidence.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Wootton Bassett colt who showed a bit more than on debut when fifth of 10 in novice at Newmarket (7f, good to soft) 17 days ago. Upped in trip but looks one for the longer term.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: From a good family but was sent off 200/1 and could hardly have shown any less on debut at Southwell (7f) just under 6 weeks ago. Upped in trip.

finals.race: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Three-time C&D winner who scrambled home in a thin 0-95 at Redcar on penultimate start. Bit to find at the weights, even if stepping forward from his recent Catterick run (beaten 2½ lengths following 10 weeks away).

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
finals.comment: Multiple C&D winner who arrives in excellent heart having finished runner-up in 7f events on his last 4 starts, suited by the end-to-end gallop when narrowly denied by a game 3-y-o at Kempton on latest. Lines up off a career-high mark but should again be on the premises for a yard flying at present.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
finals.comment: Turned around his fortunes when capitalising on much reduced mark over C&D on return, proving strong in the finish in refitted cheekpieces. Fresher than most at this time of year and can go well again if headgear continues to have a positive effect.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
finals.comment: In excellent form on all-weather at the start of the year with 3 wins (including over C&D). Ran better than for a while when beaten 2 lengths at Chelmsford (1¼m) latest. Only 1 lb above his winning mark now and place claims if they go a good pace here.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
finals.comment: Has really taken off this autumn, winning twice here, most recently staying on strongly over this trip, and a 4 lb rise is more than offset by the return of a 5-lb claimer who has already won on him. Looks primed for a third course success.
